name: Guru Kumaresan
bio: Guru Kumaresan is a master of Silambattam with over 25 years of experience. He has trained hundreds of students across Tamil Nadu and is dedicated to preserving the traditional martial art form.

name: Guru Selvam
bio: Guru Selvam specializes in Kalaripayattu and has been teaching for 18 years. He is known for his expertise in weapon-based martial arts training.

name: Guru Rajan
bio: Guru Rajan is a senior instructor with 30 years of experience in Silambattam. He has conducted workshops across India and internationally.

name: Guru Priya
bio: Guru Priya is one of the leading female Silambattam instructors in Chennai. She specializes in training women and children in traditional martial arts.

name: Guru Muthu
bio: Guru Muthu has been practicing Silambattam for 20 years and specializes in advanced weapon forms including surul kambu and sedikuchi.

name: Guru Vasanth
bio: Guru Vasanth is a dedicated Kalaripayattu instructor from Thoothukudi. He has trained numerous students in traditional combat techniques.

name: Guru Baskaran
bio: Guru Baskaran has been teaching Silambattam in Salem for 14 years. He is known for his expertise in traditional stick fighting techniques and has trained many state-level competitors.

name: Guru Murugan
bio: Guru Murugan is a senior Silambattam instructor from Tenkasi with 22 years of experience. He specializes in traditional forms and weapon-based combat techniques.

name: Guru Pandian
bio: Guru Pandian is a Kalaripayattu instructor based in Viruthunagar with 16 years of teaching experience. He is dedicated to preserving traditional combat arts in southern Tamil Nadu.

name: Guru Devaraj
bio: Guru Devaraj has been practicing and teaching Silambattam in Thiruvallur for 11 years. He conducts regular training sessions and has produced several district-level champions.

name: Guru Srinivas
bio: Guru Srinivas is spreading Silambattam in Andhra Pradesh from Tirupati. He has been training students for 9 years and regularly organizes workshops across the region.

name: Guru Harsh
bio: Guru Harsh is a dedicated Silambattam instructor based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. With 8 years of experience, he is introducing this traditional Tamil martial art to students in western India.

name: Guru Vikram
bio: Guru Vikram has been teaching Silambattam in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh for 7 years. He is passionate about promoting South Indian martial arts in northern India.

name: Guru Prakash
bio: Guru Prakash is based in Bhubaneswar, Odisha and has been teaching Silambattam for 6 years. He conducts regular training camps and demonstrations across the state.

name: Guru Aniket
bio: Guru Aniket is a Silambattam instructor from Mumbai, Maharashtra with 8 years of experience. He has trained numerous students in the Mumbai metropolitan region.

name: Guru Ramesh
bio: Guru Ramesh is a Kalaripayattu instructor based in Mysore, Karnataka with 13 years of experience. He is known for his expertise in weapon-based martial arts and has trained students across Karnataka.
